composition_variation: Illustrate Arale Norimaki from Dr. Slump in an original sunny garden scene, standing with both feet planted and holding one colorful paper pinwheel at chest height. Preserve her purple hair, large round glasses, bright red cap, and cheerful curious smile. Dress her in an opaque long-sleeved cream shirt, full-length blue denim overalls, socks, and sneakers; use age-appropriate child proportions. Render soft colored-pencil textures, mint hedges, butter-yellow flowers, and gentle morning light. Keep the upper 28% quiet for a clock and the face inside x240-784 of the 1024x1536 canvas. One character only, no lettering, logos, UI, weapons, or other people. Do not copy an existing panel, frame, or promotional artwork.
